title: Rebrand to Hulft
goal: Rename the product from Neethi to Hulft: Neethi is used by someone else (user, 2026-11-15). Hulft is after Hulftsdorp, the courts' district in Aluthkade, Colombo. The mark becomes a capital H drawn as an old Roman temple front (the columned shape of the old Parliament and of courts), minimal and plainly about law.
for_whom: A practising Sri Lankan lawyer seeing the product on the public site, at sign-in and in the app.

done_check.check: No 'Neethi' is left in app/ (a case-insensitive grep finds none outside comments that cite the old brief by its slug): page titles and description, the landing, coverage, terms and privacy pages, the header's 'Open Hulft', the sidebar label, the composer's 'Hulft is working…', and chat's 'Hulft did not read this in this chat'.

The mark is the gabled H with the scales, as agreed on the board ('Hulft · more law'): two solid stems cut to a gable (together a courthouse roof, the gap its door), the crossbar a balance beam on a small pivot, in the theme's oxblood (lighter in dark). It reads at 16 px (the tab) and 18 px (in chat). The wordmark beside it is 'Hulft' in Instrument Sans, as today. app/icon.svg is the same mark, white on the oxblood tile.

Every place the old arch was drawn shows the new mark instead: the sign-in panel's large outline, the landing's dotted drawing by the case card, the 404's dotted drawing, and the hero's dot field (a pediment, not an arch). No arch path is left in app/.
While an answer is being researched, the beam rocks on its pivot like scales weighing (the colleague at work); with reduce motion, it holds still.
brand.tsx and docs/APP.md say what the name and mark mean (Hulftsdorp; the courthouse and the scales), and the checks pass.

scenarios.steps: Open the landing, then sign in and ask a question in a case.
scenarios.expect: Hulft and the new mark in the header, the tab's title and icon, the sidebar, the composer while it works, and beside the answer; no Neethi anywhere.

scenarios.steps: Switch to dark mode and look at the header and the chat at 390 px wide.
scenarios.expect: The H is still legible and on-brand in both themes and at phone width.

out_of_scope: The Clerk app name (sign-in screen and emails), the Vercel project, any domain: the user renames them in their dashboards.
Rewriting past briefs (neethi-redesign etc.): they are history.
The Oxblood colours and fonts, and CSS token names.
A trademark search: HULFT is also Saison Technology's file-transfer product; noted to the user, accepted (different market).

decisions.note: Name Hulft, after Hulftsdorp (user). Mark: capital H as a Roman temple front (user), replacing the arch; wordmark capitalised 'Hulft' to match the capital H. Preview before sign-off since the mark is judged by eye.

Mark, after three rounds on the board (user): serifed temple H's were 'ugly'; asked for minimal, then 'more law'. Chosen: the gabled H with the crossbar as a balance beam on a pivot. Wordmark stays Instrument Sans 'Hulft'. User: every SVG changes, not only the logo.
